name: Mid Bucket (DPD 31–90)
description: Negotiation calls for 31–90 days past due. Goal: payment plan or partial payment, compliantly.

criteria.question: Did the agent greet the customer and identify themselves and Kaveri Finance?
Did the agent verify they were speaking to the borrower before discussing the loan?
criteria.context: Asking for name confirmation, DOB or last 4 digits of the loan account counts.

criteria.question: Did the agent inform the customer that the call is recorded?
Did the agent ask why the payments were missed?
Did the agent acknowledge the customer’s situation with empathy?
Did the agent assess what the customer can realistically pay now?
Did the agent state the total overdue amount and number of missed EMIs?
Did the agent explain the consequences of continued non-payment factually (credit bureau reporting, charges)?
Did the agent offer at least one option (partial payment, revised date, restructuring request)?
Did the agent log the dispute and share a reference number?
Did the agent share a resolution timeline?
Did the agent confirm collection follow-ups pause while the dispute is reviewed?
Did the agent avoid threats, intimidation or coercive language?
criteria.context: Threatening legal action, police, visiting the home/workplace, or shaming fails this.

criteria.question: Did the agent stay polite and avoid abusive or humiliating language?
Did the agent avoid disclosing loan details to anyone other than the borrower?
Did the agent secure a specific promise-to-pay amount and date?
Did the agent confirm how the customer will pay (UPI, payment link, branch, auto-debit)?
Did the agent recap the commitment before ending the call?

outcomes.label: Promise to Pay
outcomes.description: Customer committed to a specific amount and date for the overdue amount.

outcomes.label: Partial Payment Agreed
outcomes.description: Customer agreed to pay part of the overdue amount with a date.

outcomes.label: Restructure Request
outcomes.description: Customer asked for EMI restructuring; request raised.

outcomes.label: Dispute Raised
outcomes.description: Customer disputes the amount or charges.

outcomes.label: Refused to Pay
outcomes.description: Customer declined to commit to any payment.

outcomes.label: Wrong Party
outcomes.description: Borrower not reached; someone else answered or wrong number.

extractionFields.description: Primary reason the customer gives for missing the payment.
Amount the customer promised to pay, in rupees. Null if no promise.
Date the customer promised to pay, as said on the call.
How the customer said they will pay.
True if the customer describes genuine financial hardship (job loss, medical emergency).

targetingRules.description: Only when the customer raises a dispute
